FNaFW-v1.1.0.description:
# New
- Halloween Land and Geist Lair are now randomized into the pool
   - You'll need `Halloween Land Access`/`Geist Lair Access` to enter the respective area from now on
   - Adds 2 extra checks, each for entering the respective area
- Added a new YAML setting (`halloween_minigame`)
   - Randomizes the portals to the minigames in Halloween Land into the pool when turned on
   - Adds 4 new locations for entering each minigame: `<Minigame>: Enter`
   - Adds 4 new items to the Pool: `<Minigame> Access`
- Added an "UPDATE" button to every screen
   - Reloads every item recieved when pressed
   - Allows the game to not constantly check for new items, reducing lag
   - Automatically fixes some issues with items not being recieved
   - You do NOT need to always press the "Update" button, the game also checks for the items when loading a new screen (e.g. pressing the "Bytes" button)
- Made the path to Halloween Land more visible
- Added an `archipelago.json` to the .apworld (so that it doesn't get unsupported when v0.7.0 of Archipelago releases)
- Changed the description of some YAML settings to be more clear

# Fixes
- Fixed `Warp Item` doing nothing when having the setting `area_warping` set to `warp_item`.
- Fixed Logic issues, specifically issues with `Warp Item` and `Progressive Animatronics`
FNaFW-v1.1.0.title: FNaFW Archipelago: v1.1.0

FNaFW-v1.2.0.description:
# New
- Added new YAML option(s)
  - `multiple` and `any` are now valid options for `ending_goal`
  - `multi_goal` is a new YAML option (only works if `multiple` was picked in `ending_goal`)
  - `cheap_shop` is a new YAML option (replaces the `cheap_endo` YAML option)
- Changes to `hard_logic` have been made (they aren't final yet)
- Added the dancing bear (and gave him some friends)


# Fixes
- Rearrenged some objects on the Overworld to prevent softlocks
- Added a new Object to prevent the player from getting to places that they are not supposed to.
- Readded/fixed some visuals effects (please report if you find any more)
- Rephrased some YAML options

# Planned
- New way(s) of patching FNaFW
- Difficulty Logic
- Fix anything if it is broken
FNaFW-v1.2.0.title: FNaFW Archipelago: v1.2.0

FNaFW-v1.2.1.description:
# New
- Added `true_random_no_halloween` to `Initial Characters`

# Fixed
- Not being able to send out any checks with certain YAML options.
- Shop Hints now properly show ingame.
- Shop Prices are now properly halved from every shop (if the YAML option is turned on).
- Hopefully fixed the `Dusting Fields: Enter` check not sending out if you teleport into Dusting Fields before walking into Choppy's Woods.
- Fixed Halloween Characters not being in the pool when `true_random` is set as `Initial Characters`
- Fixed issues with Plando
- Something else that I forgot about that was annoying to fix

# Removed
- Removed `multiple` as a goal option, it will be readded latests before v1.3.0.
- Removed the `multi_goal` YAML option after that it would do nothing without `multiple` anyways.
FNaFW-v1.2.1.title: FNaFW Archipelago: v1.2.1
